sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Flying Grimace are built around the simple yet effective formula of shooting and destroying as many Grimaces as possible within a given time limit. Players control their ship using mouse, keyboard, or touch controls, and use their limited bullets to target and eliminate their enemies. The game's simple controls make it easy to pick up and play, but its challenging level progression and increasing difficulty ensure that players will have to stay focused and sharp if they want to succeed.
 
One of the key features of Flying Grimace is its use of a limited bullet system. This means that players can't just spray and pray, but must instead carefully plan their shots and use their bullets wisely if they want to progress through the game. This adds a level of strategy and depth to the game that sets it apart from other arcade shooters, making it more challenging and rewarding for players.
 
The game's core mechanics are also complemented by a range of power-ups and special abilities that players can collect throughout the game. These power-ups can give players temporary boosts to their speed, firing rate, or damage output, making it easier for them to clear out waves of enemies and progress through the levels. However, these power-ups are limited in number and must be used strategically if players want to get the most out of them.
